identityBinding: Resolve repository, snapshot, question, node, and evidence identities from the actual fixture import at materialization time. No such identity values are stored here.

evidenceBindingPolicy.rangeMatch: Use the exact path and source anchor first. A containing or overlapping evidence span may be considered only after filtering by the expected edge kind, endpoint or variable target, and confidence; span overlap alone never selects evidence.
evidenceBindingPolicy.callDirectionAndPath: Bind each scored call citation to the current snapshot CALLS edge with the requested caller, callee, and verified confidence.
evidenceBindingPolicy.variableFlow: Bind write, read, and return separately to WRITES, READS, and RETURNS edges targeting the named variable. Resolve by edge role even when ranges coincide. Emit a citation for each role with its own current evidenceId and set structuredAnswer.roles.citationIndex to that citation's index.
evidenceBindingPolicy.backgroundRanges: Ranges listed as context may inform explanation design but are not required scoring citations unless listed in scoringEvidenceBindings.
evidenceBindingPolicy.unknownFacts: Keep unknown confidence unknown; never promote it to verified because the source text resembles a known method call.
evidenceBindingPolicy.ambiguity: If a selector has no unique current-snapshot match after all relation filters, leave the case unresolved. Never guess or synthesize an evidenceId.
